game.name: Divinity II : The Dragon Knight Saga (Europe)(Fr,De)
game.desc: Divinity II: The Dragon Knight Saga on Xbox 360 is a definitive edition of Divinity II that includes the enhanced version of the base game, Ego Draconis, and its add-on Flames of Vengeance. The expansion picks up the story where the original game leaves off, and adds many more quests.
